stage: after the first Batch 28 production run and before finalization
scope: source best-fit direction diagnostic and deterministic simulation boundary
observed_issue: The predeclared absolute accuracy gate can label a forecast as an edge without comparing it with the unconditional majority direction. In the first run, the 1000-path result was correct in 12 of 16 origins, exactly matching an always-positive forecast because 12 of 16 realized annual returns were positive.
non_discretionary_correction: A direction forecast can be called an edge only if it passes the original absolute accuracy and Wilson-lower-bound requirements and strictly exceeds the realized majority-direction benchmark accuracy.
effect_on_risk_gates: none; source direction forecasts are diagnostic only and are not used by any Monte Carlo safety gate or portfolio allocation
reproducibility_issue: Independent process runs reconstructed economically identical weekly returns with floating-point differences around 1e-16, which changed downstream byte hashes.
reproducibility_correction: Round reconstructed weekly simple returns to 12 decimal places before simulation and evidence serialization. This is at least eight orders of magnitude smaller than a basis point and does not select or tune a result.
